# pulse_component_type (Resource)

Manages one organization-scoped Pulse component type. Deletion is rejected while any component references the type.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `green_label` (String) Label rendered for green state.
- `name` (String) Organization-unique component type name.
- `red_label` (String) Label rendered for red state.
- `unknown_label` (String) Label rendered for unknown state.
- `yellow_label` (String) Label rendered for yellow state.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Pulse component type UUID.
- `revision` (Number) Configuration revision used for optimistic concurrency.
